Know what to ask before you visit.

  • Which assessment and training services are available at this location?
  • What is included in the service, and what is purchased separately?
  • What are the confirmed prices, schedules and booking requirements?
  • What should you bring, and is there any preparation for the assessment?
  • How does this service connect with your Orb plan and progress?
Assessment and membership are different

A Blueprint assessment helps establish findings and next steps. Hub training or membership is a separate service choice. The inclusions and availability of each must be confirmed locally.

Does Orb Pro include in-person training?
Professional care and in-person services are optional and purchased separately. Confirm the local service and app-plan inclusions before purchasing.
Can I take Blueprint at a hub?
Centre-based assessment is one of the experiences introduced on this website. Participating locations, package contents and booking availability still need confirmation.
